statements.text: Polite, respectful talk with friends is part of a balanced social life.
Responsible behaviour in the class chat, including not sharing a classmate's personal information without permission, is part of a balanced social life.
A friendly class chat guarantees that every post in it is responsible.

stem:
Diya wants a balanced social life during adolescence. She meets friends after school and also messages in a class chat.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Respectful face-to-face talk and responsible online behaviour both count; a friendly chat does not guarantee responsible posts.
